theme_and_archetype.description: A cinematic, dark-mode-default financial marketing experience. Blends 'Old Money' trust with cutting-edge tech. Heavy use of deep space blacks, raw metallic accents (gold/bronze), and high-fidelity 3D WebGL interactions. No flat purple or teal gradients.

scales.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-light tracking-tight leading-none
scales.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl font-light tracking-tight leading-tight

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing, Architectural Grids, Optical Alignment
spacing_and_layout.surfaces: Crystal Glass variant for sticky headers (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/50 border-b border-white/10). Solid flat dark backgrounds for cards with 1px subtle border.

motion_and_3d.library: React Three Fiber (R3F) + Drei, Framer Motion
motion_and_3d.hero_3d: Interactive 3D abstract metallic geometric shapes (coins/cubes/torus) floating and slowly rotating in the hero section. Must react to mouse movement.
motion_and_3d.scroll_effects: Scroll-triggered reveals using Framer Motion (whileInView). Parallax scrolling for background images.
motion_and_3d.micro_interactions: Hover states on cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and reveal a subtle gold 'Tracing Beam' border or inner glow.

hero_bg.description: Modern dark architecture to be used behind the 3D canvas as a low-opacity context image.

abstract_3d_fallback.description: Metallic geometry fallback for mobile or when 3D WebGL context is loading.

team_manager_1.description: Professional wealth manager for About/Testimonial section.

pages_and_sections.Navbar: Sticky, glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050505]/60`), minimalist logo 'Om Financial', primary CTA 'Consultation'.
pages_and_sections.Hero: Centered text over 3D R3F canvas. Massive H1: 'Master Your Wealth.' Subtitle body text. R3F Canvas showing metallic geometry. Scroll indicator icon at bottom.
pages_and_sections.Services: Bento Grid layout (Tetris mode). Cards for Investment/Wealth Management, Insurance/Loans, General Financial Consulting. Use Framer Motion 3D tilt effects on cards.
pages_and_sections.About: Split layout. Text on left with animated numerical counters (e.g., '$10B+ Managed'). Right side: image of wealth manager or architectural office.
pages_and_sections.Pricing: 3-column grid. Dark glassmorphism cards. 'Standard', 'Premium', 'Elite'. Elite card highlighted with Gold Tracing Beam border and slightly scaled up.
pages_and_sections.Testimonials: Framer Motion carousel or grid. Cards with client photos, ratings, and italicized serif quotes to add luxury contrast.
pages_and_sections.Contact: Grid layout. Left: Contact info, Map placeholder, Static Phone strictly displaying '9717857755'. Right: Inquiry Form using custom Shadcn UI (dark mode tailored, gold focus rings).

component_strategy.buttons: Primary: Solid Gold bg (`bg-[#D4AF37]`), black text, font-medium, rounded-md. Secondary: Transparent, 1px solid white/20, text white, hover bg white/10.
component_strategy.cards: Dark flat background (`bg-[#0A0A0C]`), 1px solid `border-white/10`. No heavy drop shadows; use subtle inner glow instead.
component_strategy.inputs: Shadcn UI tailored. Background black/50, border white/10, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#D4AF37].

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei three framer-motion @phosphor-icons/react lucide-react
Import Cormorant Garamond and Outfit fonts via Google Fonts in index.css
Implement the 3D Hero using R3F. Create a <FinancialGeometry /> component with metallic materials (MeshStandardMaterial with high metalness/roughness) and glowing lighting.
For scroll animations, wrap sections in Framer Motion <motion.div> with whileInView for elegant fade-up and staggered reveals.
In the Contact Section, STRICTLY include the phone number '9717857755' in a prominent, static display.
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., 'data-testid="hero-cta-button"').
Use standard pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts (Hero, About, Services). Use Shadcn components heavily customized for Forms and Inputs.
Avoid any purple, teal, or bright neon gradients. Stick to the void black, slate, and gold palette to maintain the 'Om Financial' premium luxury aesthetic.
